key_reasons: After conversion the four-bedroom house has one space; Table T2.1 needs two plus a cycle store and the site is outside the Town Centre Zone (T2).
The extension comes within 3.2 m of a protected lime with no tree survey or method statement, so harm cannot be ruled out (ENV3).
The 3.8 m depth (drawing 03) is within H4's 4.0 m for terraces; the 4.2 m on drawing 05 is the height.
The splay requirement is waived by the highway authority in writing for this 20 mph no-through street (T2).
The side window is within 10 m of No. 63, so H4 requires obscure glazing and non-opening below 1.7 m, secured by condition.
